name: Keynote Response
description: Receives and parses Apple Keynote slide telemetry JSON sent over WebSocket by the Keynote module

ok.description: Whether the last Keynote JXA action succeeded

action.description: Last Keynote action executed (next, previous, goto, start, stop, status)

running.description: Whether Apple Keynote is currently running

playing.description: Whether a Keynote slideshow is currently playing

documentName.description: Name of the active Keynote document

totalSlides.description: Total number of slides in the active Keynote document

slideTitle.description: Title text of the current slide

slideNotes.description: Presenter notes of the current slide

skipped.description: Whether the current slide is marked as skipped

error.description: Error message if the last Keynote action failed

slideChanged.description: Triggered when slideNumber or documentName changes

responseReceived.description: Triggered whenever a WebSocket response arrives from Keynote
